ds_ops.original: WITH ops AS ( SELECT d.full_date AS sales_date, d.iso_week, d.year, p.category, p.subcategory, p.product_name, c.region AS customer_region, c.segment, s.store_name, s.store_format, s.region AS store_region, ch.channel_name, f.order_id, f.quantity, f.net_sales_amount, f.cost_amount, f.profit_amount FROM `ferrous-gate-496806-b7.retail_star.fact_sales` f JOIN `ferrous-gate-496806-b7.retail_star.dim_date` d ON f.date_key = d.date_key JOIN `ferrous-gate-496806-b7.retail_star.dim_product` p ON f.product_key = p.product_key JOIN `ferrous-gate-496806-b7.retail_star.dim_customer` c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key JOIN `ferrous-gate-496806-b7.retail_star.dim_store` s ON f.store_key = s.store_key JOIN `ferrous-gate-496806-b7.retail_star.dim_channel` ch ON f.channel_key = ch.channel_key ) SELECT * FROM ops
